title: hunkboard resolutions.json
description: The agent's answers to threads in comments.json. Written ONLY by the agent (or a human acting as one) and published next to diff.json. The viewer merges it with comments.json for display; it never writes this file.

status.description: resolved = change made; wontfix = declined with a reason; needs-info = agent asks the reviewer a question.

note.description: Agent's reply shown under the thread.

by.description: Agent identifier, e.g. codex/gpt-6-astra or claude-code.
